w: Both readers placed T3-005 and T3-021. 'Die Amis versuchen unsere Flagge zu zerstören!', '*ACHTUNG* Belgier wagen eine Attacke auf die Nordfront!', 'The Belgians are invading our flag! To arms brothers!', 'Deutschland ist im Krieg mit /r/bluecorner!', pushing the dog off the flag, 'HALTET ZUSAMMEN, KAMERADEN!' and 'Stellung halten!' fight attacks on the German flag (T3-005, all three placements), and lead by count. 'OPERATION AUFRÄUMEN', 'Operation Frühjahrsputz', 'Operation Säuberung', keeping the flag clean for the saved canvas, cleaning another corner once the eagle was recognised and maintaining only the manageable left part repair the flag with no fight called (T3-021, both readers); T3-005's must_not_show sends 'Watching for damage and repairing it ... where no fight is called (T3-021)' there. Re-ruled at B4a-05 under J's ruling of 13 October (09:09 Berlin): the old bag's also_present T3-119, T3-065, T3-076, T3-042, T3-024, T3-011 and T3-084 were named by neither reader and not by my B1, so the item is not a bag and the ruling is the readers' list. Left out: help rebuilding the French flag the room had fought ('Sag das bitte nicht meinem Opa'), 'Stoppt die Operation Annexion', halting the 'neuer Lebensraum' programme (the Nazi-era word used as a joke), and restraint at the French border and the Megaman beam.
